name: Lydia
source: She is a princess from a country that is now dead due to war. She was brought under Claude by the barbarian king who attacked her homeland, and in exchange for the lives of the king and queen who were taken hostage, she chose the path of the barbarian king's sex slaves. White Princess; as the name suggests, she has a beautiful appearance, but she is active and somewhat short-tempered who always picks fights with Claude and Elliot.
